entities.name: Hemoglobin alpha-D
observations: The 141-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q9DF25 from Chelonoidis carbonarius (100% identity and coverage; E-value 6.69e-101).
Predicted molecular weight is 16,171 Da, theoretical pI 6.23, and estimated charge at pH 7 is -3.53.
Contains a Globin Pfam domain (PF00042.29) spanning residues 26–136 with i-Evalue 2.2e-34.
Curated homolog function is oxygen transport; the subunit forms a hemoglobin tetramer with two alpha-D and two beta chains.
Curated annotations include heme binding, oxygen binding, oxygen-carrier activity, and haptoglobin binding.

No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; peroxidase and hydrogen-peroxide-catabolic GO annotations are present in the reference record but are secondary annotations rather than evidence of a primary enzyme function.

entities.name: Globin domain PF00042
observations: Pfam analysis identifies the canonical globin domain in the query sequence at residues 26–136.
The domain assignment strongly supports a hemoglobin-like oxygen-binding protein.
